senses.gloss:
भञ्ज् भञ्ज्, ii. 7, भनज्, भञ्ज्, Par.
 1. To split, Rām. 1, 67, 17.
 2. To break, Pañc. i. d. 148; to destroy, MBh. 3, 10990.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. भग्न.
 1. Broken, Pañc. 36, 12; torn.
 2. Defeated, Bhartṛ. 2, 85; Rājat. 5, 340.
 3. Disheartened, Chr. 5, 23; Pañc. iv. d. 43.
 4. Disappointed, Bhartṛ. 2, 82.
 5. Extinct, Man. 8, 148.
 6. Disregarded, humbled;
 --† i. 10, Par. To speak, to shine.
 --With the prep. अव अव, To break down, MBh. 1, 7081.
 --With नि नि, To break, Bhaṭṭ. 15, 117.
 --With विनिस् वि-निस्, विनिर्भग्न, Broken down, MBh. 3, 12477.
 --With प्र प्र, To break down, MBh. 3, 11121. The original form has been probably भ्रञ्ज्.
 --Cf. Lat. frango; Goth. brikan; A.S. bracan, brecan; ῥαγή, ῥήγνυμι, ῥηγμίν.

भञ्जन भञ्ज् + अन, n.
 1. Breaking, destroying.
 2. Afflicting.
